about: Creatures shown at ground level. Ages in Ma (firstMa oldest, lastMa youngest). Where a species has 'pbdb', its range comes from Paleobiology Database occurrences (public/data/life/occurrences.json: paleo-coordinates on the PALEOMAP grid for ages from 2.6 Ma, modern coordinates for younger finds); 'regions' are hand-entered boxes [latMin, latMax, lonMin, lonMax, fromMa, toMa] in modern coordinates for the last few million years. Habitats: forest, rainforest, taiga, grassland, savanna, steppe, desert, tundra. All placements are approximate: a fossil-based range, a habitat match and a herd size, not a census.
